model: B(v,angle)=beta0+beta1*u+beta2*w+beta3*u*w+beta4*u^2+beta5*w^2; u=v/8,w=angle_degrees/90; speeds quantized 0.1 yd/s, angles 1 degree
optimality_scope: Minimum cardinality for full six-parameter model by rank lower bound and exact completion; numerical noise criterion selects among minimum-cardinality candidate subsets. It is not an optimal biomechanical training program.
noise_scope: Unit independent observation-noise model only; actual sensor noise and model misspecification not estimated by these algebraic calculations.
trust_boundary: Exact rational statements hold for supplied quantized design matrices and chosen quadratic surrogate. Actual athletes need not follow this model. Pooling route intent is deliberately optimistic. No real-world predictive gain or causal intervention benefit inferred.
